description: PARTIAL SAVE: writes ONLY the 'Advertising' field of TitlePublicConfigurationModel; all other v1/v2 fields stay untouched. Advertising — logical ad Placements (rewarded video, interstitial, banner, app-open), the mediation Providers that serve them (AppLovin MAX, LevelPlay, ...) with per-platform app IDs and ad unit IDs, per-format settings, frequency capping, premium ad-removal perks, GDPR/ATT consent policy, rewarded-video server-side verification (SSV) and the daily revenue import from the provider's Reporting API. Shared secrets (SSV keys, report keys) are NOT stored here — only the NAME of the TitleSecrets entry that holds them.

x-enum-descriptions: Acknowledge only ACCEPTED callbacks. A rejected one keeps being retried, which surfaces a wrong key in the provider's own dashboard instead of silently dropping rewards. Cost: retry traffic while the key is wrong, and the response differs between a valid and an invalid callback.

Acknowledge EVERYTHING, including rejected callbacks. No retries and no observable difference between a valid and an invalid callback. Cost: the provider's dashboard looks healthy, so a wrong key is only visible in our own AdEventLog (InvalidSignature outcome).

CurrentPolicyVersion.description: Current privacy-policy version. Bumping it invalidates previously stored consents and forces a re-prompt.

RegulatedRegions.description: ISO country codes where consent collection is mandatory. Outside this list ads run under legitimate interest.

RequirePersonalizedAdsConsent.description: Whether explicit consent for personalized ads is required.

RequireTrackingConsent.description: Whether explicit tracking consent is required (ATT prompt on iOS).

AdCreditSinkDefinition.description: One place where RewardedVideoCredit is spent (see AdvertisingDefinitions.CreditSinks). The server guarantees only that the credit is debited exactly once and within the configured limits; it cannot deliver what was paid for, because the mechanic is client-side. Use for conveniences (reroll, continue, speed-up), never as the gate to server-side value — that must be paid for by the operation that grants it.

Cost.description: How many credits one unit costs. Anything below 1 is treated as 1: there is no free sink, that would be a mere counter.

DailyLimit.description: How many times per UTC day this sink may be spent. 0 = unlimited.

Enabled.description: A disabled sink answers with a denial but stays in the config.

Gate.description: Who the sink is available to. null/empty = everyone. Unified platform gate — resolved by SegmentGateEvaluator.Passes.

MaxUnitsPerRequest.description: How many units one request may spend. A larger request is clamped, not rejected.

SessionLimit.description: How many times per game session this sink may be spent. 0 = unlimited.

SinkID.description: Sink identifier — also the key in Advertising.CreditSinks and in the player's counters. Must not contain '.' or '$': it becomes a path inside the Mongo document.

AdFrequencyCappingSettings.description: Global ad frequency caps counted across all formats, applied on top of per-placement and per-format limits.

MaxImpressionsPerDay.description: Maximum ad impressions per UTC day. 0 = unlimited.

MaxImpressionsPerHour.description: Maximum ad impressions per hour. 0 = unlimited.

MaxImpressionsPerSession.description: Maximum ad impressions per game session. 0 = unlimited.

AdPlacementDefinition.description: One logical ad placement. Concrete SDK ad units are bound through AdProviderDefinition.Units keyed by the same PlacementID.

AllowedProviderIDs.description: Provider whitelist for this placement. null or empty means every enabled provider is allowed.

CooldownSeconds.description: Minimum interval between impressions of this placement, in seconds. Checked against the player's LastShownAt. 0 = no cooldown.

CreditsRewarded.description: Base amount of RewardedVideoCredit granted per verified view on this placement. Meaningful only for RewardedVideo and RewardedInterstitial; ignored otherwise.

DailyImpressionCap.description: Maximum impressions of this placement per UTC day. 0 = unlimited.

PlacementID.description: Unique placement identifier. Used as the key in Advertising.Placements and in the player's Advertising.Placements. Must not contain '.' or '$'.

Type.description: Ad format type of this placement.

AdProviderDefinition.description: Configuration of one ad SDK provider (AppLovin MAX, LevelPlay, AdMob, ...).

AndroidAppID.description: Provider app ID for the Android build.

IosAppID.description: Provider app ID for the iOS build.

Kind.description: Mediation vendor; selects the SSV verification algorithm and the report-import strategy. Absent = AppLovinMax.

Priority.description: Provider priority in mediation. Higher value = higher priority in the client SDK waterfall.

ProviderID.description: Unique provider identifier within the title (e.g. "applovin").

Reporting.description: Report-import settings for this provider. Absent = fall back to the root Advertising.Reporting, and only for AppLovinMax. Resolved by AdReportingDefaults.EffectiveFor.

Units.description: Ad unit IDs per placement. Key is AdPlacementDefinition.PlacementID.

WebAppID.description: Provider app ID for the Web build.

x-enum-descriptions: AppLovin MAX: the publisher composes the callback URL from macros, signature is sha1(EVENT_ID + Event Key), the response body is ignored.

Unity LevelPlay (formerly ironSource): the provider composes the callback URL with its own fixed parameter names, signature is md5(timestamp+eventId+userId+rewards+privateKey), and the response must carry an acknowledgement body or the callback is retried.

AdProviderReportingSettings.description: Report-import settings for ONE provider; overrides the root Advertising.Reporting where present. A separate block is required because vendors need a different number of credentials: AppLovin authenticates with a single Report Key, LevelPlay with a PAIR (Secret Key + Refresh Token) exchanged for a bearer token.

Enabled.description: Whether report import is enabled for this provider.

RefreshTokenSecretName.description: Name of the TitleSecrets entry holding the SECOND credential, for vendors that need a pair. LevelPlay Refresh Token; unused for AppLovin.

RevisionWindowDays.description: How many recent days to re-pull on every import. 0 = inherit the root Advertising.Reporting.RevisionWindowDays.

SecretName.description: Name of the TitleSecrets entry holding the primary reporting credential: AppLovin Report Key, or LevelPlay Secret Key. The value is never exposed.

AdReportingSettings.description: Daily import of revenue from the provider's Reporting API. This is the only source that matches the actual payout; it arrives a day late and keeps being revised for a few more days, so the import re-pulls a window of recent days rather than just yesterday.

Enabled.description: Whether report import is enabled for this title.

RevisionWindowDays.description: How many recent days to re-pull on every import. The provider keeps revising a closed day for several days, so a one-shot import would freeze an unrevised number forever. Default 4.

SecretName.description: Name of the TitleSecrets entry holding the provider's Report Key. The key is PER TITLE, not per publisher: one publisher may hold several mediation accounts. The value is never exposed.

x-enum-descriptions: Rewarded video: watched to completion, grants the player a reward.
Hybrid of interstitial and rewarded: shown like an interstitial but grants a reward when watched to completion.
Ad shown when the app returns from background.
Native ad embedded into the game UI.

AdUnitConfig.description: One ad unit: platform-specific IDs for a given placement at a given provider.

Type.description: Expected format of this ad unit. Must match the placement's Type; the server validates this when issuing a permit.

AdVerificationSettings.description: Server-side verification (SSV) settings for rewarded video. Only shared-secret providers are supported (AppLovin MAX, Unity LevelPlay); the secret lives in TitleSecrets and is referenced by name only.

ClientGrantFallbackSeconds.description: How many seconds to wait for the SSV callback after the client reports completion before granting the reward without it. 0 (default) = never grant without SSV. Only meaningful when RequireServerSideVerification is true; a late callback is idempotent and never double-grants.

MaxPendingRequestsPerUser.description: Maximum concurrent pending requests per player. Guards the player document against pending-request flooding.

PendingRequestTtlSeconds.description: Pending request TTL in seconds; after it expires the request can no longer be confirmed. Typical range 60-180.

RejectedCallbackAck.description: What to answer a callback that FAILED signature verification. Only meaningful for vendors that require an acknowledgement body (LevelPlay); AppLovin ignores the body. Default AckAcceptedOnly.

RequireServerSideVerification.description: Whether SSV confirmation is required before crediting the player. When false the client's own completion report is trusted (test/dev mode).

SecretNameByProvider.description: Name of the TitleSecrets entry holding the provider's shared secret (e.g. AppLovin Event Key). Key is ProviderID, value is the secret NAME such as "APPLOVIN_EVENT_KEY". The secret value itself is never stored here and never leaves the server.

SignatureMode.description: AppLovin ONLY. Which provider token to verify. EventToken (default) is sha1(EVENT_ID + key) as documented; EventTokenAll covers every callback parameter but its canonical string must be confirmed against a live callback before enabling. Providers of other Kinds have a single documented scheme and ignore this field.

AppOpenSettings.description: App-open ad settings (shown when the app returns from background).

CooldownSeconds.description: Minimum interval between app-open impressions, in seconds.

DailyImpressionCap.description: Maximum app-open impressions per UTC day. 0 = unlimited.

Enabled.description: App-open switch, applied on top of the master Advertising.Enabled switch.
Banner switch, applied on top of the master Advertising.Enabled switch.

MaxImpressionsPerMinute.description: Maximum banner impressions the server accepts per minute of permit lifetime. A banner physically refreshes no faster than RefreshIntervalSeconds, so anything well above that rate is fabricated by the client. 0 disables the check.

PermitTtlSeconds.description: Banner permit lifetime in seconds; default 6 hours. Separate from the shared TTL because a banner lives for the whole session and keeps reporting against its permit, while a fullscreen ad is done in a minute.

RefreshIntervalSeconds.description: Banner auto-refresh interval in seconds. Typical range 30-60.

x-enum-descriptions: Platform was not reported, or the reported one contradicts the request fingerprint.
Browser: web build, WebGL, or a messenger mini-app.

ExperimentVariantCondition.description: Experiment-variant membership condition — embedded in SegmentGate.Experiment. The gate passes if the player is assigned to one of Variants of experiment ExperimentID (empty list = just enrolled). A/B variants thus reuse the whole SegmentGate stack: make two configs (offer A, offer B), each gated to its variant.

ExperimentID.description: Experiment ID whose assignment is checked.

Variants.description: Allowed variants (any-of). Empty = being assigned to any variant is enough (enrolled). A player with no assignment for this experiment does NOT pass.

CooldownSeconds.description: Minimum interval between interstitial impressions, in seconds, on top of the per-placement cooldown.

DailyImpressionCap.description: Maximum interstitial impressions per UTC day. 0 = unlimited.

MaxImpressionsPerSession.description: Maximum interstitial impressions per session. 0 = unlimited.

MinSessionTimeBeforeFirstSeconds.description: How many seconds from session start interstitials are suppressed, protecting the first minutes of gameplay.

PremiumAdReduction.description: Premium perk that disables ad formats for subscribers. Enforced server-side before a permit is issued. Single best matching tier wins, no stacking.

DisableAppOpen.description: Disable app-open ads for subscribers of this tier.

DisableBanners.description: Disable banners for subscribers of this tier.

DisableInterstitials.description: Disable interstitials for subscribers of this tier.

MinPremiumTier.description: Minimum tier required to qualify for this modifier.

RequiredPremiumID.description: Optional specific subscription ID. null = any subscription matching MinPremiumTier.

RewardedVideoSettings.description: Global rewarded-video settings, shared by every rewarded placement.

DailyCreditEarnCap.description: Maximum credits a player may earn per UTC day. 0 = unlimited.

DailyViewCap.description: Maximum rewarded views per UTC day across all placements. 0 = unlimited.

DefaultCreditsPerView.description: Default credit reward used when the placement's CreditsRewarded is 0.

MaxCreditsBalance.description: Maximum RewardedVideoCredit balance a single player may accumulate. 0 = unlimited.

MinSecondsBetweenViews.description: Global minimum interval between rewarded views of different placements. Prevents bypassing per-placement cooldowns by switching placements.

SegmentGate.description: Unified "who it is available/applies to" gate. Replaces BoostSegmentGate (TimedBoost), MailboxSegmentDefinition filters and StoreOfferRules premium fields. All conditions are AND-ed. An empty/unset field = no constraint on that axis; an empty/null gate = available to everyone. Resolved by SegmentGateEvaluator.Passes.

ActiveWithinDays.description: Active within the last X days (matches Usage.LastActiveAt). 0 = no restriction.

Countries.description: Country filter (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; matches PublicData.Country, else RegistrationCountry). Empty = all countries.

Experiment.description: A/B experiment condition: the gate passes only if the player is assigned to the required variant (ExperimentVariantCondition). null = not applied. A/B variants thus reuse the whole SegmentGate stack: two configs, each gated to its variant. Assignment is read from UserDataDocument.Experiments (sticky, stable-hash — see ExperimentAssigner).

MaxLevel.description: Maximum Board Rank. 0 = no upper bound.

MinLevel.description: Minimum Board Rank (matches PublicData.BoardRank). 0 = no lower bound.

MinPremiumTier.description: Minimum active premium tier (matches Premium.MaxActiveTier). 0 = no requirement.

Platforms.description: Platforms the entity is available on. Empty/null = all. Unlike the other axes this one comes from the request platform (IGSService.ClientPlatform), not from the player document, and is passed to SegmentGateEvaluator.Passes as a separate REQUIRED argument. The axis is skipped when the platform is Unknown — deliberately soft, because it governs what is shown, not what is charged: payments are guarded by PriceOptionSelector.IsAvailableOn, where Unknown does not pass a non-empty platform list. Not needed to hide entities that simply cannot be paid for on a platform: storefronts already drop whatever has no available price option.

RegisteredWithinDays.description: Registered no earlier than X days ago (new players; matches RegistrationDate). 0 = no restriction.

RequiredPremiumIDs.description: Required active premium IDs (ANY of the list is enough, via PremiumHelpers.GetActivePremiumIDs). Empty = no requirement.

Segments.description: Allowed economy segments (matches PlayerEconomyTuningState.Segment: "F2P","Dolphin","Whale","VIP"). Empty = any.

Tutorial.description: Tutorial condition: the gate passes only if the player is in the required progression state (TutorialGateCondition). null = not applied. By the same trick as Experiment, this gives "after onboarding" gating in every module already using SegmentGate, with no edits to them. To close a whole module there is a cheaper path — TutorialGlobalSettings.Blocking: one check in ClientRun instead of a condition on every entity.

TutorialGateCondition.description: "The player finished the tutorial" condition — embedded in SegmentGate.Tutorial exactly as ExperimentVariantCondition is embedded in SegmentGate.Experiment. Thanks to that, tutorial gating works for free in EVERY module already using SegmentGate (Store / DealOffer / Quest / Reward / Leaderboard / ...). This is the per-entity gating level; to close a whole module use TutorialBlockingPolicy, which is cheaper.

FlowIDs.description: Flows whose state is checked. Empty = the condition is not applied (the gate passes). Multiple entries are AND-ed: "after the intro AND after the raid tutorial".

Mode.description: What exactly must hold for those flows. Default Completed.

Negate.description: Invert the condition. Needed for the reverse case — "show this starter offer ONLY to players still in the tutorial". Default false.

SkippedCountsAsCompleted.description: Whether a Skipped flow counts as finished under Mode = Completed. Default true: if the publisher allowed skipping, the skipper must get the same game as the completer.

StepID.description: The step that must be reached. Read only when Mode = StepReached, and applied to every flow in FlowIDs.

x-enum-descriptions: The flow is started (in progress or already finished).
A specific step has been reached (TutorialGateCondition.StepID).

value.description: Title-level advertising configuration: placements, SDK providers, per-format settings, frequency capping, premium ad reductions, consent and rewarded-video server-side verification.

CreditSinks.description: Catalog of places where the player may SPEND RewardedVideoCredit. Key is AdCreditSinkDefinition.SinkID. Normally the credit is spent by the very operation it pays for and needs no sink; this catalog is for spends whose mechanic is entirely client-side and therefore has no server operation of its own (ability reroll inside a run, continue-after-death, skipping an offline timer). Cost and limits come from config, not from the client: the client only names the sink.

Enabled.description: Master switch for the whole advertising system. When false the server rejects every ad permit/impression request regardless of per-placement settings.

FrequencyCapping.description: Global frequency caps applied on top of per-placement and per-format limits.

MaxClientRevenueMicrosPerImpression.description: Cap on client-reported revenue per single impression, in micro-USD (1 USD = 1000000). Anything above is clamped and flagged. Client-side revenue can be forged, and one player could otherwise poison the report the publisher buys traffic on. Default 5000000 ($5) is generous for a real impression. 0 disables clamping (test stands only).

Placements.description: Catalog of logical ad placements. Key is AdPlacementDefinition.PlacementID.

PremiumAdReductions.description: Premium perks that disable ad formats for subscribers. Single best matching tier wins, no stacking (standard PremiumTierModifier selection).

Providers.description: Ad SDK provider configuration. Key is AdProviderDefinition.ProviderID (e.g. "applovin").

Reporting.description: LEGACY single-provider report import, kept for back-compat (it predates multi-provider support and describes AppLovin only). Per-provider settings live in AdProviderDefinition.Reporting and win; this block is consulted only when a provider has none AND its Kind is AppLovinMax. Resolution lives in AdReportingDefaults.EffectiveFor.

RewardedVideo.description: Global rewarded-video settings shared by all rewarded placements.

Verification.description: Server-side verification (SSV) settings for rewarded video.
